scripts.build: npm run build -w @zen-syllabus/core && npm run build -w @zen-syllabus/cli
scripts.test: vitest run --config vitest.config.ts && npm run test -w @zen-syllabus/worker
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run deploy:dry-run
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run dev -w @zen-syllabus/worker
scripts.deploy:dry-run: npm run build && npm run deploy:dry-run -w @zen-syllabus/worker
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy -w @zen-syllabus/worker
